lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for 7 kinds of change with only 1 test; rules are stated only when at least 2 tests agree.
'home, wait_info' and 'finish, new_screen' are helpful, supported by multiple winning tests (3 of 7 and 2 of 5 won, respectively).
'adoption, redesign' and 'sign_in, redesign' consistently hurt performance across tests.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, layout', 'adoption, notification', 'choose_path, layout', 'sign_in, hint', and 'sign_in, incentive', as all tests yielded no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' and 'choose_path, hint' remain inconsistent across tests.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for unhelpful changes and underpredicted gains on unexpected winning tests.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen System Audio Preview
candidates.change: Displays an ambient sound toggle and loading info badge on the waiting screen to engage users while waiting.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and high drop-off. Lessons show 'home, wait_info' is supported by multiple winning tests.

guard.reason: Valid addition of audio component and time estimate to the waiting screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: home, wait_info is a proven winning pattern (+2.1% average lift), though low step drop-off caps total impact.

candidates.why: Support mails highlight confusion around controlling and hiding pets. Lessons show 'finish, new_screen' is helpful.

components.text: Double click system tray to hide/show pet

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new post-home_intro onboarding screen explaining pet interaction controls.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment with support tickets and supported by proven finish, new_screen gains (+1.3%).

guard.reason: Valid addition of a status checklist component to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Proven positive change type (+2.1% lift), addresses long duration on home screen.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new companion pledge screen inside the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Targeting largest drop-off step (adoption), but adding flow steps adds friction and tends to fail.

candidates.score_note: Targeting choose_path duration, but screen redesigns consistently hurt performance (-1.7%).

candidates.score_note: Notification toggles have shown negative lift (-2.0%) in previous tests.
